opportunities.query_text: FinOps Professionals - Agentic AI Cost Overruns. Uber burned its entire 2026 AI budget in four months, and had to cut back on usage. Agentic AI cost just doesn't behave like traditional software that we know how to budget for. I spent years at Apptio building the tooling that made cloud spend predictable, and that playbook doesn't survive contact with agents. Most teams are learning that lesson the hard way. My new piece is on why agentic AI keeps blowing out of budget, and what makes it so hard to see coming. Would like to hear from others how they are managing their AI costs. #AgenticAI #FinOps #AI

opportunities.query_text: Looking for experts in dynamic pricing and other related strategies. I'm writing about dynamic pricing and what it means for consumers. I'm also looking at such variations as AI dynamic pricing, surge pricing, surveillance pricing, and the difference between variable and dynamic pricing. How long have all of these been around, what's the history of the concept, etc. Any good stories of how dynamic pricing has gone really well or badly? It's for Forbes online, I'm trying to do a few interviews by Wednesday, please, only well-qualified sources, and I'd appreciate some bullet points to show expertise.
opportunities.contact_method: Contact via Substack link or X DM
opportunities.relevance_notes: About AI dynamic pricing and consumer impact, not directly about AI tool subscription overlap. But AIToolsEssentials tracks pricing trends (Microsoft 365 +16%, ChatGPT Pro split $120/$200, GitHub Copilot usage-based) — these are examples of AI vendors adopting dynamic/usage-based pricing. Can offer verified pricing shift data as evidence of how AI pricing is becoming more variable and harder for consumers to budget.
opportunities.suggested_pitch_template: Template 1 (AI Tool Pricing Changes, reactive) — adapted: offer verified data on AI tool pricing shifts toward usage-based/dynamic models (GitHub Copilot AI Credits, ChatGPT Pro tier split, Cursor Auto billing per-model). Frame as 'AI dynamic pricing is already happening in the tool subscription market.' Provide bullet points showing expertise as requested.
